data.description:
## Description

**What**: Wire Bug-Fix Mode to resolve current sub-branch from S7's `DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING:` anchor before committing fix-bug output; remove cross-mode 'uniformly' preamble language; co-locate sub-branch instructions per-mode (Bug-Fix Mode, Phase F, Phase G) section headers.

**Why**: Mitigates the bot-psychologist-flagged Instruction Locality risk that 'applies uniformly to Bug-Fix Mode, Phase F, Phase G' could be misread by an orchestrator as 'same sub-branch shared across modes'.

**Scope**:
- IN: Bug-Fix Mode's per-ticket loop: after each fix-bug invocation, resolve current sub-branch from the most-recent `DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING:` anchor (S7) and commit fix-bug output to that sub-branch; remove 'uniformly' language from the debug-everything preamble; add per-mode sub-branch instructions to Bug-Fix Mode, Phase F, and Phase G section headers (Phase F/G already covered by S4/S5).
- OUT: Compaction-resume fence (S7); leak detection (S9); review wiring (S6).

## Done Definitions

- When complete, Bug-Fix Mode commits fix-bug output to the current sub-branch resolved via the most-recent `DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING:` anchor, not to the session branch
  ← Satisfies: "Mechanism applies to Bug-Fix Mode with instructions co-located in section header"
- When complete, the debug-everything SKILL.md preamble does NOT contain cross-mode 'uniformly' language; each of Bug-Fix Mode, Phase F, and Phase G section headers contains its own sub-branch instructions
  ← Satisfies: "Mechanism applies to Bug-Fix Mode, Phase F, Phase G — with instructions co-located in each mode's section header"
- Unit tests written and passing covering Bug-Fix Mode commit routing through the resolved sub-branch
  ← Satisfies: "Mechanism applies to Bug-Fix Mode"

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] Per-mode co-location is the prompt-correctness fix surfaced by the bot-psychologist review; preserve this pattern when adding any future cross-mode behavior

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an orchestrator, Bug-Fix Mode commits fix-bug output to the current sub-branch via the DEBUG_BRANCH_TRACKING anchor; per-mode instructions are co-located in each mode's section header
